chat.askDocsUser: Can you explain what this warning light is?
chat.askDocsAnswer:
That amber engine light is the **MIL** (Malfunction Indicator Lamp) on your Ducati Panigale 1299s.

The owner’s manual covers it on pages 28, 196 and 201:
• Engine fault stored in the ECU
• Risk of limp mode or a no-start
• Side-stand / inhibit sensor issues can also trigger it

Want me to check this vehicle’s logbook for recent workshop notes related to the engine or sensors?
chat.askDocsCallout: Have the vehicle inspected by an authorized Ducati dealer. Do not ignore a steady MIL.

problem.label: Not an ordinary tracker.
problem.title: Costs, consumption and maintenance in view? GarIQ does more.
problem.copy: GarIQ turns your vehicle into more than data: you get the overview, keep control, and have everything that matters exactly where you need it — alone or together.

cards.title: What belongs to the vehicle stays with the vehicle.
cards.copy: Registration, insurance, purchase contract and owner's manual are all stored in one place. Everything stays together, at hand, where you expect it — with your vehicle.

cards.title: The story belongs to the vehicle. Not the owner.
cards.copy: When a car changes hands, the history often starts from zero. In GarIQ it stays with the vehicle. When you sell, you show what was done over the years and how it was looked after — and you hand the story to the next driver. A car with a memory, not just a used car.

cards.title: Several vehicles. One garage. One shared overview.
cards.copy: Your car, your motorcycle, the family car or your second car – each vehicle has its own place and its own story. Share your garage with partner, family or colleagues and look after your vehicles together. Everyone sees the same information and can keep the vehicle history current. You decide who writes along and who can do more. Separate where it should stay separate – and shared where you need it shared.

cards.title: Timeline and statistics. The story behind the numbers.
cards.copy: Every entry tells a piece of your vehicle. The timeline brings those moments together across the years; statistics make visible what otherwise stays hidden: costs, consumption, and how they change. Single data points become a clear picture of your vehicle.

cards.title: Oil, tyres and more. Today's state, always in view.
cards.copy: See at a glance what counts for your vehicle today: when the oil level was last checked, how many days and kilometres have passed since, and which tyres are currently mounted. No hunting through notes, no old workshop receipts — the current state of your vehicle, exactly when you need it.

cards.title: Your story. Your format. Your data.
cards.copy: What GarIQ has gathered, you can take with you anytime — as a clear PDF to read and share, or as CSV to work with yourself. Your vehicle history does not only live in GarIQ: you have it exactly where you need it.

solution.copy: GarIQ keeps events, attachments, and document vault files under your account. Invite co-owners when you need help logging — without turning your garage into enterprise software.

items.a:
GarIQ turns your vehicle into more than just a vehicle. It gives it a digital history that grows with every fill-up, every service, every invoice, every trip and every important event.

You keep an overview of costs, consumption and current condition, can follow your story over the years, keep documents to hand and simply query your own vehicle data. You can use vehicles together with others, manage several vehicles in one place and even pass the complete history on to the next owner.

GarIQ connects everything that makes up your vehicle — so you always know what was, what is, and what you want to know from it.
No. You can use GarIQ for different vehicles — for example cars, motorcycles, or several vehicles in your family. Each vehicle keeps its own story and its own information.

items.q: What can I document with GarIQ?
items.a: Among other things you can document refuels, charges, maintenance, workshop visits, insurance, taxes, inspections, expenses, trips, notes and other events around your vehicle.

items.q: Can I share my vehicle data with others?
items.a: Yes. With a shared garage, several people can access the same vehicles and their information. Partners, family members or other co-users can work on the vehicle history together. You can decide who has which rights.

items.q: What happens to the vehicle history when I sell my vehicle?
items.a: The history can be transferred to the new owner together with the vehicle. The buyer does not only get a used vehicle — they can also follow its documented story.

items.q: Can I manage several vehicles with GarIQ?
items.a: Yes. You can manage several vehicles in one app. Each vehicle has its own space and its own story, while you still have everything in one place.

items.q: Can I export my data from GarIQ?
items.a: Yes. Your vehicle data can be exported as a clear PDF or as a CSV file. You can read, share or work with the information yourself.

items.q: Can I see how much my vehicle really costs?
items.a: Yes. GarIQ can evaluate your logged expenses and consumption and show you statistics on how your vehicle develops. You see not only individual costs, but also connections and changes over time.

items.q: Can I see the current state of my vehicle?
items.a: Yes. On the home screen you can see important current information at a glance — for example the last oil check, the days and kilometres since then, or the tyres currently mounted.

items.q: How can I add information in GarIQ?
items.a:
However is easiest for you: manually with a form, via chat, or simply with a photo or a PDF. The AI analyses the information, picks out the relevant data and prepares an entry. You review the suggestion, confirm it — and only then is it saved.

**You provide the information. GarIQ turns it into a finished entry.**

items.q: What if I don't know which event type something belongs to?
items.a:
No problem. You don't need to know where a piece of information belongs in GarIQ. **Smart Scan** picks up relevant information from photos and files and helps assign it to the right event type. **Smart Log** does the same for information you enter via chat. GarIQ prepares a matching entry — you review it and decide whether it is saved.

**You don't need to know where it belongs. GarIQ helps you with that.**

items.q: Does the AI save information automatically?
items.a: No. The AI creates a suggestion, but nothing is saved automatically. You always decide whether the suggested information is kept.

items.q: Can I ask GarIQ questions about my vehicle?
items.a:
Yes. Just ask GarIQ in natural language what you want to know about your vehicle. For example: How much did I spend on my vehicle this year? How has consumption developed over the last three years? When was the last service? What does my insurance or the handbook say? Which repairs have already been done?

GarIQ searches the information stored on your vehicle and puts the relevant data together for you. You do not need to know where something is stored — you only need to know what you want to know.

items.q: Don't understand a warning on the vehicle? Show it to GarIQ.
items.a:
An unknown warning light, a symbol or a message on the display? Take a photo and just ask GarIQ what you see and what it might mean. The AI analyses the image and helps you understand faster what your vehicle is trying to tell you.

**Don't search. Just show and ask.**

GarIQ is for anyone who wants more from their vehicle history: private owners, families with several vehicles, motorcycle and tuning enthusiasts, collectors, and small businesses with their own fleet. Also for anyone who does maintenance, repairs or modifications themselves and wants to document hours, costs and the work done. GarIQ is especially valuable if you document your vehicles over the long term and want to keep the complete story for a later sale.

items.q: Why should I use GarIQ instead of notes, Excel or a folder?
items.a: Because your vehicle data is then no longer scattered across different places. GarIQ connects information, documents, events, statistics and the vehicle history in one place — and makes that information easier to access, share and use.

askLog.subtitle: You forget. <brand></brand> doesn’t. Ask it.
askLog.description: GarIQ is your vehicle’s memory. Premium up this year? Last inspection passed? More kilometres on which fuel? What consumption? Workshop spend this year? This isn’t a random chat: it’s Ask on the logbook, on events already confirmed. One question, and that memory answers — without reopening the year, hunting the receipt, or going to the web.

askDocs.subtitle: A warning light flashing? What’s covered? <brand></brand> knows.
askDocs.description: Which oil does the manufacturer recommend? What tyre pressure? Windscreen cracked: does insurance cover it? Warning light on: what does it mean? Photograph the light: GarIQ says what it means. Photograph the oil bottle: it says whether it’s the right product. The photo is checked against the uploaded manual and policy, not the web. Upload the owner’s manual and the vehicle policy. No flipping three hundred pages for one line. One question, and the answer comes from the file.

smartScan.subtitle: Photo or PDF: <brand></brand> reads and gets it.
smartScan.description: Not sure what type of event it is? Photograph the receipt or upload the PDF. GarIQ reads the document and works it out — a fill-up, a workshop bill, an invoice. Date, amounts, litres or km land in the draft. You check, edit if needed, confirm. What goes in the logbook is your call.

smartLog.subtitle: No photo? No file? Tell <brand></brand>.
smartLog.description: Tell the event in your own words — a fill-up, a service, tyres, a shop job. GarIQ works out the event type and asks when something is missing (date, km, amount, parts). Then you get a filled-in draft: check it, edit if needed, confirm. What goes in the logbook is your call.

items.copy: You don't want to type. Snap the receipt, check the draft, save — and drive off knowing it's done.

items.title: …leaving the workshop.
items.copy: Dictate a sentence with the numbers in your head. Months later, ask when that service was and at which km.

items.title: …before a long trip.
items.copy: Ask "When was my last oil check?" and see the date and the km — peace of mind from your logbook, not your memory.

items.title: …needing a policy detail.
items.copy: It's in the vault. Ask the document instead of digging through email.

items.title: …sharing the keys.
items.copy: You and your partner drive the same vehicle. One garage, one timeline — fewer "I thought you did it."

comparison.label: Compared to what you use today
comparison.title: No invented competitors — just the categories people actually try first.
comparison.copy: GarIQ isn't a feature more than a spreadsheet. It's a different category: capture, confirm, and ask — on your own vehicle history.
